name: gaia-codex
description: Use Codex with OAuth-backed Gaia MCP for general platform operations and project-bound workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Use live Gaia tools and project workflows from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Gaia Codex gives Codex a reusable workflow for OAuth-backed Gaia MCP. It supports general platform operations such as discussion investigations even when a repository has no Gaia project binding, while keeping project-scoped reads, patches, workflow tests, and live changes tied to an explicit project.
defaultPrompt: Connect this repository to its Gaia project.
Investigate this Gaia discussion through the Gaia MCP tools.
Preview a Gaia project patch before applying it.
